```xml
<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<bpmn:definitions xmlns:bpmn="http://www.omg.org/spec/BPMN/20100524/MODEL"
                  id="definitions"
                  targetNamespace="http://example.org/bpmn">

  <!-- Collaboration and participants -->
  <bpmn:collaboration id="Collaboration_1">
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_Organisation" name="Organisation" processRef="Process_1" />
  </bpmn:collaboration>

  <!-- Process -->
  <bpmn:process id="Process_1" isExecutable="false">

    <!-- Lanes -->
    <bpmn:laneSet id="LaneSet_1">
      <bpmn:lane id="Lane_Database" name="Database">
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_1_BackupDatabase</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_2_CheckDefaulterTable</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_6_RegisterDefaultingAccounts</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_14_ReconcileDefaulters</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
      </bpmn:lane>
      <bpmn:lane id="Lane_CRM" name="CRM System">
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_4_CheckCRMForReturns_NoDefaulter</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_5_CheckCRMForReturns_DefaulterPath</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_12_CheckCRMAfterReport</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
      </bpmn:lane>
      <bpmn:lane id="Lane_AccountMgmt" name="Account Management">
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_8_ProduceDefaultingTable</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_9_SendTableToAccountMgmt</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
      </bpmn:lane>
      <bpmn:lane id="Lane_Supervisor" name="Supervisor">
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_11_AlertSupervisor_2_30</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_16_MessageSupervisor_4_00</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
      </bpmn:lane>
    </bpmn:laneSet>

    <!-- Flow nodes -->
    <bpmn:startEvent id="StartEvent_1" name="Start weekday morning" />

    <bpmn:task id="Task_1_BackupDatabase" name="1. Backup database" />
    <bpmn:task id="Task_2_CheckDefaulterTable" name="2. Check Account Defaulter table for new records" />

    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_3_NewDefaulterRecords" name="3. New records in Account Defaulter?" />

    <!-- Path when no new defaulter records -->
    <bpmn:task id="Task_4_CheckCRMForReturns_NoDefaulter" name="4. Check CRM system for new returns" />
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_5_NewReturns_NoDefaulter" name="5. New returns exist?" />

    <bpmn:task id="Task_6_RegisterDefaultingAccounts" name="6. Register defaulting accounts and customers" />
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_7_ClientCodesAdvised" name="7. Client codes previously advised?" />

    <bpmn:task id="Task_8_ProduceDefaultingTable" name="8. Produce another table of defaulting accounts" />
    <bpmn:task id="Task_9_SendTableToAccountMgmt" name="9. Send table to account management" />

    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_10_Deadline_2_30" name="10. Completed by 2:30 pm?" />
    <bpmn:task id="Task_11_AlertSupervisor_2_30" name="11. Alert supervisor (after 2:30 pm)" />

    <bpmn:endEvent id="EndEvent_1_Success" name="End – process completed" />
    <bpmn:endEvent id="EndEvent_2_Alert" name="End – alert sent" />

    <!-- After report completed, second part -->
    <bpmn:task id="Task_12_CheckCRMAfterReport" name="12. Check CRM system for new returns (after report)" />
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_13_NewReturns_AfterReport" name="13. New returns filed?" />

    <bpmn:task id="Task_14_ReconcileDefaulters" name="14. Reconcile with existing account defaulters table" />
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_15_Deadline_4_00" name="15. Completed by 4:00 pm?" />
    <bpmn:task id="Task_16_MessageSupervisor_4_00" name="16. Send message to supervisor (after 4:00 pm)" />

    <!-- Sequence flows -->
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_1" sourceRef="StartEvent_1" targetRef="Task_1_BackupDatabase" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_2" sourceRef="Task_1_BackupDatabase" targetRef="Task_2_CheckDefaulterTable" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_3" sourceRef="Task_2_CheckDefaulterTable" targetRef="Gateway_3_NewDefaulterRecords" />

    <!-- Yes – new defaulter records -->
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_4_Yes" name="yes" sourceRef="Gateway_3_NewDefaulterRecords" targetRef="Task_6_RegisterDefaultingAccounts" />
    <!-- No – no new defaulter records -->
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_4_No" name="no" sourceRef="Gateway_3_NewDefaulterRecords" targetRef="Task_4_CheckCRMForReturns_NoDefaulter" />

    <!-- CRM check after no defaulter records -->
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_5_Yes" name="yes" sourceRef="Gateway_5_NewReturns_NoDefaulter" targetRef="Task_6_RegisterDefaultingAccounts" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_5_No" name="no" sourceRef="Gateway_5_NewReturns_NoDefaulter" targetRef="EndEvent_2_Alert" />

    <!-- After registration, decide on client code advice -->
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_7" sourceRef="Task_6_RegisterDefaultingAccounts" targetRef="Gateway_7_ClientCodesAdvised" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_7_Yes" name="yes" sourceRef="Gateway_7_ClientCodesAdvised" targetRef="Gateway_10_Deadline_2_30" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_7_No" name="no" sourceRef="Gateway_7_ClientCodesAdvised" targetRef="Task_8_ProduceDefaultingTable" />

    <!-- Produce and send table -->
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_8" sourceRef="Task_8_ProduceDefaultingTable" targetRef="Task_9_SendTableToAccountMgmt" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_9" sourceRef="Task_9_SendTableToAccountMgmt" targetRef="Gateway_10_Deadline_2_30" />

    <!-- Deadline 2:30 check -->
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_10_Yes" name="yes" sourceRef="Gateway_10_Deadline_2_30" targetRef="Task_12_CheckCRMAfterReport" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_10_No" name="no" sourceRef="Gateway_10_Deadline_2_30" targetRef="Task_11_AlertSupervisor_2_30" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_11" sourceRef="Task_11_AlertSupervisor_2_30" targetRef="EndEvent_2_Alert" />

    <!-- After report completed, second CRM check -->
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_12" sourceRef="Task_12_CheckCRMAfterReport" targetRef="Gateway_13_NewReturns_AfterReport" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_13_Yes" name="yes" sourceRef="Gateway_13_NewReturns_AfterReport" targetRef="Task_14_ReconcileDefaulters" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_13_No" name="no" sourceRef="Gateway_13_NewReturns_AfterReport" targetRef="EndEvent_1_Success" />

    <!-- Reconciliation and deadline 4:00 -->
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_14" sourceRef="Task_14_ReconcileDefaulters" targetRef="Gateway_15_Deadline_4_00" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_15_Yes" name="yes" sourceRef="Gateway_15_Deadline_4_00" targetRef="EndEvent_1_Success" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_15_No" name="no" sourceRef="Gateway_15_Deadline_4_00" targetRef="Task_16_MessageSupervisor_4_00" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_16" sourceRef="Task_16_MessageSupervisor_4_00" targetRef="EndEvent_2_Alert" />

    <!-- End flows for successful path after first part (if no second part needed) -->
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_EndSuccess" sourceRef="Gateway_10_Deadline_2_30" name="yes" targetRef="EndEvent_1_Success" />

  </bpmn:process>
</bpmn:definitions>
```

- If no new records -> check CRM system for new returns. If new returns exist -> register all defaulting accounts and customers.

- If the defaulting client codes have not been previously advised, produce another table of defaulting accounts and send to account management.

- All of this must be completed by 2:30 pm, else alert supervisor.

- Once the new defaulting account report has been completed, check the CRM system to see whether new returns have been filed. If new returns have been filed, reconcile with the existing account defaulters table. Must be completed by 4:00 pm else supervisor message.

So steps after registration produce report, send to account management, then deadline check.

Then after report completed, again check CRM for new returns, reconcile, deadline.
